title: Reader Chapter 14
hook: A reader-facing chapter under phase-1 review.

breakdown.fullRead: Title: One Forecast Conversation Scenario: On the call, analyst the analyst taps a Coinstar spreadsheet beside his keyboard. "The forecast is careful," he says. The investment partner answers, "Careful about which future?" The page names the middle case, but Byron Penstock's logic asks for the edges too. The analyst reads the downside risk aloud, then the upside potential. The call changes once both ends are in the room. What to do: The analyst keeps the forecast, then asks the investment partner to test the low and high cases before the investment judgment is made.
